idea_status_detail: Two A100 rounds preserved correctness, 5673.0 MiB block cache, and 29884 MiB peak process GPU memory versus opt012 while improving e2e generated throughput by 0.137%; decode throughput regressed by 1.54%, so this is retained only as a bounded e2e/memory tradeoff pending independent review.

implementation.default_api_behavior: Unset/empty RETROINFER_LATE_BLOCK_CACHE_INIT resolves to zero and preserves existing torch.zeros allocation for all preallocated and late block-cache K/V tensors.

policy_values.uninitialized: opt-in torch.empty allocation only for cache_keys/cache_values allocated in prepare_cache() after prefill
policy_values.zero: default zero-filled late block-cache K/V allocation

implementation.safety_basis: WaveBufferCPU initializes clusters as misses and only marks inBlockCache during batch_update; gather_copy_and_scatter writes admitted cache blocks before later cache-hit reads can source from cache_keys/cache_values.

limitations: No profiler or CUDA timeline was collected; no overlap or allocation-kernel speed claim is made.
Decode throughput regressed versus opt012 and opt010; retained status rests only on same memory with small e2e improvement versus opt012.
The e2e improvement is two-round, single-shape A100 evidence and should be independently reviewed before promotion.
Uninitialized allocation is safe only under the recorded WaveBuffer miss-before-admission invariant; it is not applied to preallocated block cache or other tensors.

block_cache.late_init_safety: WaveBufferCPU starts all clusters as cache misses and marks cache hits only after gather_copy_and_scatter writes admitted K/V blocks

throughput.e2e_generated_tokens_per_s_formula: batch_size * gen_len / e2e_latency_s, averaged per run

path_coverage: 2/2 opt013 logs printed RETROINFER_LATE_BLOCK_CACHE_INIT=uninitialized, block_cache_late_init_effective=true, mode=uninitialized_empty, late_uninitialized_bytes=5948571648, tensor_count=64, correctness groundtruth present, block_cache_allocated_after_prefill=true, and peak_process_gpu_memory_mib=29884.0.
summary: Default-off uninitialized late block-cache allocation passed 2/2 A100 120000x8 correctness runs, kept 5673.0 MiB block cache and 29884 MiB peak GPU memory, used torch.empty for 64 late K/V cache tensors totaling 5948571648 bytes, improved e2e generated throughput versus opt012 (3.268888 vs 3.264410 tok/s), and regressed decode throughput versus opt012 (198.037 vs 201.132 tok/s).
